name: Whole Wheat Pancakes
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Mix the dry ingredients in one bowl.
In another bowl, beat the egg, then add the other wet (liquid) ingredients. This includes the 2 tbsp of oil.
Mix the dry and wet ingredients together, well enough to eliminate dry spots but no more.
Heat a frying pan to medium heat, and grease it with some oil. The pan is hot enough when a drop of water dances around rather than simply boiling away.
With a spoon, pour a pancake about 10 cm (4 inches) in diameter, using about 60 ml (¼ cup) of batter. The pancake will bubble.
When the bubbling settles down and the edges are slightly dry, flip the pancake.
When the pancake looks golden and done, remove it and start another one.
